sentences.text: The product note’s statement that no foreclosure charge applies to individual borrowers on floating rate loans for non-business purposes matches the in-force UCB direction for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 to individual borrowers for purposes other than business.
The evidence does not show the sanction date, so the RBI rule’s applicability to this loan remains unknown.

The bank’s own documents also state both that a pre-payment charge applies on foreclosure or pre-payment and that no foreclosure charge applies for individual borrowers on floating rate non-business loans.
The current RBI material also contains other pre-payment-charge directions, but the rule findings say they are not enough to decide this case without the missing sanction-date information.

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB direction for existing floating rate term loans and the rule findings for pre-payment charge applicability; the sanction date was not provided.
Reviewed the rule findings for pre-payment charge applicability; the facility type was not provided.
